subject: Pilot alignment: scope amendment, success metrics & next steps (Cartique)
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma_li@cartique.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Recap + next steps: Pilot scope & evaluation — Cartique

Hi Emma — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single reference.

What we walked through / agreed (high level):
- Add "refund-extraction" as a secondary use case to the pilot (examples in attachment).
- Keep primary focus on customer support routing/chat assist intents.
- Adjust the success criteria to include an explicit human-in-loop accuracy check for refund extraction (see metrics below).
- Customer will provide a ~2k-row anonymized sample dataset for ingestion by end of week.

Proposed evaluation plan and success criteria (Redwood + Cartique):
1) Intent accuracy: classification F1 >= 0.88 on the primary support intents (measured on held-out set).
2) Refund-extraction: field-level precision >= 0.92 and manual spot-check pass rate >= 95% over sampled items with human-in-loop.
3) Latency: median per-token latency target < 150ms; 95th percentile end-to-end inference latency < 350ms for 512 token sequences.
4) Operational: ingestion pipeline validated and runbook for data refresh; infra smoke tests green before live testing.

Timeline (proposed):
- 11/24: pilot kickoff & data handoff (sync call, 30m).
- 11/24–11/30: data ingest + baseline runs + instrumentation (Redwood engineering).
- 12/1–12/14: evaluation window (2 weeks) with daily pass/fail checks and weekly demo.
- 12/15: final evaluation review and go/no-go.

Owners:
- Cartique: Emma Li (data provision + acceptance owner) / contracts@cartique.com (procurement).
- Redwood: Sergio Alvarez (engagement lead), Laura Bennett (solutions + eval), Aditya Rao (runtime/config).
- CS/ops: Monica Patel (post-trial rollout readiness).

Attachments included: redwood-poc-scope-v2.pdf (scope doc), eval-metrics-template.xlsx (metrics tracker), SOW-draft.docx (commercial).

Ask: Please confirm the amended scope (adding refund-extraction) and the timeline above. If good, confirm availability for a 11/24 10:00am PT kickoff — happy to send calendar invite and invite the procurement contact.

Thanks —
Sergio
Sergio Alvarez

Thanks, Sergio — that summary looks good and aligns with our notes. A couple small clarifications: 
- For refund-extraction, we want an explicit human-in-loop review step where our agents approve extracted fields before any downstream action. Can we add that to the acceptance checklist?
- We'll aim to deliver the anonymized 2k sample by EOD 11/23. Our procurement team (contracts@cartique.com) asked that the SOW include a 30-day extension option; can your team comment on standard language?

Confirming I'm available 11/24 at 10:00am PT for kickoff. Please send the invite.

Best,
Emma Li
Head of Product, Cartique Inc.

Subject: Internal: Cartique pilot — scope add (refund-extraction) and rebaseline tasks

Team — quick internal note and asks after Emma's confirmation. Keeping action-focused: 

Decision points / asks:
- Add refund-extraction as a tracked use case. Laura — can you update the eval-metrics-template to include a human-in-loop pass rate and a field-level precision sheet? Target: precision >= 0.92 and sampling plan for spot checks.
- Aditya — infra/load: run a small end-to-end smoke with 512-token slices and capture 95p latency. If the 95p > 350ms, propose we switch to the slightly larger batch config we tested in staging (cfg-v3). Please surface expected CPU/GPU utilization.
- Monica — prepare a short runbook template for Cartique handoff and post-trial readiness checks (data refresh cadence, rollback instructions).

Timeline adjustment: procurement asked for a 30-day extension opt-in on SOW — I'm going to add standard language, but legal may need to review. Laura / Aditya, can you turn around the updated metrics doc and the smoke run results by COB 11/24 so we have everything for the kickoff?

I'll draft the kickoff invite and include Emma + procurement. Attaching the current scope doc for reference.

Thanks —
Sergio
